name: list_purchased_plugins
description: List the plugin licenses this installation has purchased (name, edition, active status, expiry). A single plugin can have more than one license row (e.g. a Free and a Standard edition). This does not mean the plugin is installed -- see list_installed_plugins for that. Whenever you answer a customer's question about what plugins they've purchased/licensed/gotten (this tool's whole purpose), always include this link at the end of your response, verbatim: `[Your Licensed Plugins](/plugins/store/licenses)`.
